description: The agent must: (1) Navigate to /home/devuser/workspace/night-patch and read the SKILL.md and config/default.yaml to understand the workflow. (2) Invoke './start.sh dry-run' FIRST as mandated by the safety principle ('先测试后使用'). (3) Read ~/.bash_history, count command frequencies, and identify candidates with ≥3 uses (min_usage_count=3 from config). (4) Invoke './start.sh' (actual run) which writes exactly ONE alias to ~/.bashrc — critically NOT to ~/.bash_aliases, because SKILL.md explicitly states .bashrc is used for better compatibility. (5) Verify that max_changes_per_night=1 is respected — only one alias is added. (6) Confirm that logs/night-patch-execution.log, logs/night-patch-audit.log are created with meaningful content. (7) Confirm that a markdown report logs/night-patch-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md exists containing: execution summary, the alias created, a rollback instruction using 'unalias <name>', and a security audit section. The proprietary traps are: writing to .bashrc not .bash_aliases, applying the min_usage_count=3 threshold from config, the max_changes_per_night=1 single-change limit, and the mandatory dry-run-first safety pattern.
